cohort: Nulliparous women with term, singleton, vertex (NTSV) pregnancies
finding: Elective induction of labor (eIOL) at 39 weeks may not be associated with a reduced NTSV cesarean delivery rate.
mod_finding: Elective induction of labor (eIOL) at 39 weeks in nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex pregnancies was not associated with a reduced cesarean delivery rate compared to expectant management.
